title: picardDerivedUnitNormalization
statement: For schemes W and V and r:V to W [def-pc-scheme] with the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], define e_r:Lr^*(O_W[0]) isomorphic to O_V[0] by the canonical single-pullback comparison [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison] followed by the single embedding of the ordinary unit map pullbackObjUnitToUnit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Both maps are invertible for the structure sheaf, as supplied by the existing comparison theorem and the ordinary unit instance. This is the actual composite isomorphism, with no data postponed.

def picardDerivedUnitNormalization (W : Scheme.{v}) :
  ∀ {V : Scheme.{v}} (r : V ⟶ W),
    (derivedPullback r).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace))) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings V.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings V.toRingedSpace))
